## Architectures

<a id="codi"></a>

### CoDi

Composable multimodal diffusion.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11846)

![CoDi — Figure 2](../assets/architectures/codi.png)

*Figure 2 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11846)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, I, V, A → T, I, V, A · **Interaction:** generation

Any-to-any generator based on diffusion; retained as an omni predecessor, not counted as a SpeechLM.

</details>

<a id="duplex-model"></a>

### Duplex Model

Duplex-adapted LLM and streaming speech modules.

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → T, S · **Interaction:** system

System-level real-time interaction with separately connected speech components.

**Variants:** Duplex Model.

</details>
